projectContent.text:
Keter Group has been an innovative player in Israeli plastic manufacturing since 1948. Not by chance, Keter Plastic is responsible for the Israeli version of a monobloc chair named “Club Chair 2”. Keter’s monobloc plastic chairs share a collective memory associated with funerals, large public events, massive brawls, and more. As a result, monobloc chairs have earned a place of honor in modern Israeli art–used by artists Anna Mirkin, Ori Shifrin Anavi, and more. The hoodie incorporates an image taken by artist and Con board member Neil Cohen.

Original screen print by artist Neil Cohen

1982 Keter Plastic ad for toilet accessories
